simple.meaning: גָּדַף (gâdaph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to hack (with words), i.e. revile.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 7 times across Numbers, 2 Kings, Psalms, Isaiah, Ezekiel, beginning at Numbers 15:30. Its contexts include birth, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּדַף (H1442).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: גָּדַף (gâdaph) / H1442 is traced through Numbers 15:30, 2 Kings 19:6, 2 Kings 19:22, Psalms 44:17 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: “ ‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master this: ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!
All this has come on us,

“Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

definitions.full: H1442. gadaph [ גָּדַף ] verb only Pi`el revile, blaspheme (Late Hebrew גָּדַף cut, wound , then (especially Pi) revile ; Arabic cut, cut off , II. deny a favour, be ungrateful , etc.; Aramaic Pa`el גַּדֵּף , , revile ) — Perfect 2masculine singular וְגִדַּפְתָּ 2Kin 19:22 = Isa 37:23 ; 3 plural גִּדְּפוּ 2Kin 19:6 = Isa 37:6 ; Participle מְגַדֵּף Num 15:30 ; Psa 44:17 ; — 1 revile , between man and man, (absolute) וּמְגַדֵּף מְחָרֵף קוֺל Psa 44:17 the voice of (him that) reproacheth and revileth . 2 blaspheme , followed by accusative ׳י Num 15:30 (P); 2Kin 19:22 = Isa 37:23 (|| חֵרֵף ; object אֶתמִֿי , reference to ׳י as above); Ezek 20:27 ; 2 accusative ג ׳אֲשֶׁר אֹתִי אַשּׁוּר מֶלֶךְ נַעֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים ... 2Kin 19:6 = Isa 37:6 the words with which the servants of the king of Assyria blaspheme me .
